statement: A one-page website for Petal & Stem, a flower shop in Jaipur, where visitors can see the bouquets with prices, place a delivery order through WhatsApp, and find the shop's timings and location.
audience: People in Jaipur who want to buy flowers and have them delivered, usually on a phone.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Readable and usable on a phone (360px wide) and a desktop (1280px wide)
Prices shown in rupees exactly as given
Only facts from the brief and the Requester's answers appear on the site; nothing invented
rules: Do not invent bouquets, prices, hours, addresses, phone numbers or delivery areas
Photos are not available yet, so each bouquet gets an empty photo spot instead of a stock image
Orders go only to WhatsApp +91 98290 11223; payment is on delivery
done_when: The page shows the name Petal & Stem and mentions Jaipur
The page lists exactly these five bouquets with these prices: Red rose dozen ₹899, Sunflower bunch ₹699, Mixed seasonal ₹999, White lilies ₹1,199, Orchid box ₹1,499
Each bouquet card has an empty photo spot (a visible placeholder area) ready for a photo to be added later
An order form has fields for bouquet choice (the five bouquets), customer name, customer phone number and delivery address, and refuses to submit while any of them is empty
Submitting the form opens a WhatsApp link to 919829011223 with the chosen bouquet, name, phone number and address filled into the message
The page states: same day delivery inside Jaipur for orders placed before 4pm, ₹99 delivery charge, pay on delivery
The page states opening hours of 9am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday, and closed on Sunday
The page shows the address 12 MI Road, near Panch Batti, Jaipur 302001 and the phone number +91 141 400 5566, with the phone number as a tap-to-call link
The page has a link or embedded map that points to the shop's address
The file has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, no broken in-page links, and no placeholder wording such as lorem ipsum or 'to be confirmed'
